card.summary: Free, no published per-file or per-account cap found on the site or FAQ (silence, not a stated infinity). 715,868 images currently indexed.

free_tier.stated: Free, no published per-file or per-account cap found on the site or FAQ (silence, not a stated infinity). 715,868 images currently indexed.

retention.stated: Per-object-cap: unstated; scope is restrictive. Statistical maps/parcellations/atlases only. Retention: permanent URLs.

egress.terms: Free and anonymous. `neurovault.org/media/images/...` serves with `Accept-Ranges: bytes`, `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, no auth.

record.tooling: Documented REST API (`/api/images/?format=json`, `/api/collections/`), plus the `pynv`/`nilearn` fetch-atlas path. Upload needs an account but is API-driven.
record.chaining: Unlimited collections per account; each image is an independent anonymous object. The API exposes every image's `file` URL and `file_size`, so a caller can enumerate and pull the whole corpus without auth.
record.limits_note: Per-object-cap: unstated; scope is restrictive. Statistical maps/parcellations/atlases only. Retention: permanent URLs. Read limit: none observed, no CDN in front (bare origin), so throughput is modest.
record.reliability_note: Single origin behind Cloudflare, small operator; no observed rate limiting but no stated durability guarantee.
